name: Gallery Grid
summary: Passive container-responsive list of target-owned media with regular-grid and source-flow masonry presentations.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Titled thematic section or untitled generic root for one complete media-list composition.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual heading that names the thematic root.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Required native list and responsive layout region for target-owned media items.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item containing one complete target-owned media composition.

variants.name: grid
variants.description: Regular row-major responsive grid with a private uniform media crop candidate.

variants.name: masonry
variants.description: Source-flow CSS-column presentation that preserves target media proportions.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic size whose private track counts and media geometry respond to component space.

states.name: targetInteractiveFocus
states.description: Visible native focus when target-owned interaction receives keyboard focus.

behavior.name: rootSemantics
behavior.description: A non-empty title produces a thematic section named by its visible heading; an untitled composition uses a generic root.

behavior.name: sourceOrder
behavior.description: Native list order remains authoritative in regular Grid and source-flow Masonry; no dense packing or visual reordering is allowed.

behavior.name: variantComposition
behavior.description: Grid uses a regular private crop and row-major tracks; Masonry uses natural media proportions and intact source-flow columns.

behavior.name: itemOwnership
behavior.description: The target supplies one or more complete media items and owns sources, dimensions, alternatives, loading, optional content and editor data.

behavior.name: interactionBoundary
behavior.description: Items are passive by default; only a target-owned native link or button may add focus and activation. This contract does not choose navigation, selection or Lightbox behavior.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Missing required items omits the root; an empty optional title omits only the header and selects generic root semantics.

behavior.name: runtimeBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral Web uses no component JavaScript, observer, listener, request, timer, layout measurement or focus manager.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; when present it names the thematic root.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more source-ordered target-owned native list-item compositions containing complete media semantics.

accessibility: When title is present, render a thematic section associated with the visible contextual heading through aria-labelledby; use a generic root when title is absent.
Render the finite media collection as native ul/li content without APG grid, row or gridcell roles and preserve target-authored source order across both variants.
Require at least one complete item, omit invalid empty composition, and give informative target media contextual alternatives while hiding decorative or redundant media appropriately.
Do not focus, hover-emphasize, click, select or announce passive items; only target-owned native links or buttons may add activation and visible native focus.
Keep captions and essential target content persistently available without hover and do not use crop, position, color or item order as the only meaning cue.
Gallery Grid adds no authored motion or runtime; target-owned interactive descendants remain responsible for any separate reversible motion policy.
Leave native heading rank, media delivery/loading, caption composition, Lightbox lifecycle, analytics and editor data with the owning target.

web.notes: Implemented by conditional titled-section semantics, native list fixture composition, strict required-slot omission, component-responsive Grid/Masonry CSS and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant-editable section maps optional title/variant and reorderable image blocks with explicit passive media semantics and no component runtime.
